rule: An intervention is an action on the project or tooling that the guidance or CLI output did not print or link. A decision is an unresolved Ultima setup, theme or styling choice that changed the output. Product choices and documented alternatives do not count. Browser checks of the consumer application follow the guidance; rendering documentation to retrieve guidance or source would count.
